## Fixed protocol and interpretation

The declaration below was saved before outcomes; its immutable copy is tests/scratch/codex/lead91_unit1/protocol.md.

Row declaration: “Keep exactly four terms and fixed ridge; minimize maximum training-season mean log loss, then calibrate separately. No outcome-selected season exclusions. Changes training objective, not a fifth term.” D: opener Brier primary, worst outer-season log loss diagnostic, B=5/K=5, **601 looks**.
Population: 2020–2025 archived openers, source-complete rows; retain pushes in margin distributions and exclude only from conditional-cover fits. Target-week, observation, bookmaker and kickoff clocks enforced; no closing inputs or pre-2026 pool captures. Sources: pick_probability/20260929T192747Z, opener_evaluation/20260929T192743Z, game_features_weak_stack.parquet.
Outer seasons 2023/2024/2025: fit through Y−3, selection Y−2, calibration Y−1; fixed ridge 0.001, no tuning grid or outcome-selected exclusions. Reconstruct matched moves and verify/refit upstream cutoffs using LEAD-83 machinery. Separate selection/calibration years; retrospective archive caveat.
Five arms: minimax candidate, refitted served four-term base, model-only, timestamp-matched market, Elo. One calibrated line-conditioned discrete margin probability selects each side. Report decisive records first; optimistic IS/OOS/gaps; fold coefficients/stability; opener accuracy/Brier/log loss/RPS and worst-season loss, five equal-width reliability bands, season/week-block 95% intervals and probability_positive. L=(27×5+5+4)×4+25=601; no unlisted variants. Zero crossing closes nothing; default unresolved_below_power. Diagnostic gains alone cannot promote ATS sides.
Implementation fixed before outcomes: retain LEAD-83's source-complete matched-book population and refit all upstream models through Y−3. Minimax epigraph objective is maximum season mean log loss plus 0.001×||beta||²/(2×training_n), matching the base's sum-loss ridge convention. Reuse its train-only standardization, Brier-selected nonnegative slope on Y−2, and intercept calibration on Y−1. Worst-season endpoint takes the maximum season mean loss (recomputed within each season/week-block bootstrap); 10,000 paired resamples, seed 20260929. IS uses training rows, including repeated fold training rows in pooled summaries; gaps are OOS minus IS. Push probabilities and full-grid RPS use the line-local integer-margin lattice. All optimizers use one thread.


**Measured:** all upstream margin/offset/Elo models and discrete lattices refit through Y-3; no cached weekly model probabilities used. Historical opener replaces closing spread, archived Tuesday totals replace closing totals. Hashes verify the LEAD-83 inputs and both quote archives. IS is optimistic, with repeated training rows across pooled folds. All five arms receive the same separate slope selection and intercept calibration. Calibrated cover/loss mass retains the discrete lattice's push mass and alone selects the side.

**Measured:** 1344 source-complete games including pushes; 1311 conditional-cover rows; 3 missing Tuesday totals retained as missing; 601 looks, 10,000 paired season/week-block resamples. Worst-season loss is recomputed within each draw; pooled worst-season contrast subtracts the candidate maximum from each comparator maximum. Gap intervals subtract independently resampled IS from OOS. Intervals condition on fitted models and omit full refit uncertainty.

**Inferred:** unresolved_below_power pending orchestrator recording. Three outer seasons and retrospective source reuse limit generalization. Per AGENTS.md Margins/Promotion, a diagnostic gain cannot promote ATS sides; per its weak-signal rules, zero crossing closes nothing. No card change or closure. The one-season 2023 training fold makes minimax and pooled objectives mathematically identical up to optimizer tolerance.

## IS, OOS and gaps

**Measured:** each cell is estimate [95% interval]; probability_positive. Accuracy is percentage points; other endpoints are losses. Gain rows orient all endpoints so positive favors the candidate. Gaps are OOS minus IS, also for gain rows. Raw loss probability_positive means loss above zero, not improvement. Worst-season loss duplicates ordinary log loss for single-season panels but remains a declared look.
